note: Major dialogue facts for Journal / 여행 기록. Match key: place + npc (TLK English name) + topic (TOPIC stem or job/heal). A chain is local to one place; a destination starts a new chain while goal/complete_if_recorded completes the source tip. requires_recorded gates capture until that tip id exists (e.g. Silent mantra after Pinrod). goal empty = complete on record (including learned mantras); rune:<virtue>|stone:<color>|use:stone:<color>|use:horn|shrine:<virtue>|enter:hythloth-castle|companions:7|runes:8|stones:8 = pending until action (use:stone at an altar room or matching abyss altar; use:horn near the Humility shrine; enter:hythloth-castle when descending into Hythloth from {lcb}). Collection rows for companions/runes/stones are added after the first recruit or find, not at new-game seed. Ask-tips may use complete_on_goal mantra:<virtue> as a shrine fallback. know virtue:<name>|mantra:<name>|stone:<color>|dungeon:<name>|principle:truth|love|courage fills the journal collection page; mantra:<name>, stone:<color>, and gaining a rune also mark the matching virtue. Re-hearing a recorded topic still applies new know bits. codex_only:true applies know without a travel-log row. Talk-chain goals: ask:* completed by Journal.mark_id or mark_goal when the follow-up talk happens. shrine:<virtue> completes when the party enters that shrine. Same id with upgrade:true expands an existing clue (en_upgraded/ko_upgraded on the base catalog row). Action tips use Ask / Search / Meet / Enter (묻기 / 찾기 / 만나기 / 들어가기); knowledge facts keep Topic: detail. Official place names use {paws}-style tokens resolved by Locale.fill_places from place_* keys. seed_if_recorded on a destination row inserts a nameless Ask/Meet tip there when the source town's go-find clue exists; the same ask:* goal completes both.
